items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was in Birdland playing with Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: What kind of music was played in your household? What kind of music did your family – your mother and father play?

My mother was very religious. My father was loose. He wasn’t necessarily religious. He ended up coming to see me with Charlie Parker and all those people later. He came to New York once and came to the Five Spot. I think I was there with Monk, Thelonious Monk. The household was – my mother – I had a lot of records when I was
very young, the latest jazz records. She didn’t particularly like me to play them on Sunday. She was that kind of strict.
